note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 38(2), ZIM 4; A06b Const 38(2), ZIM 4; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen keeps it on taking another (loss applies only to naturalised citizens, not modelled). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generally applicable provision), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, with no further limit on a child born abroad. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Zimbabwe, 2024
sources.said: Person has been continuously and lawfully resident in Zimbabwe for at least 10 years. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person has acquired citizenship of another state. Note: In February 2020, the Cabinet approved the revised Zimbabwean Citizenship Bill, which allows Zimbabweans by descent to hold dual citizenship. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Zimbabwe to a citizen. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born abroad to a parent who was a citizen ordinarily resident in Zimbabwe or working outside Zimbabwe for the state (in which case the person becomes a citizen by birth), or to a citizen (person becomes a citizen by descent). Other conditions: the birth is registered in Zimbabwe. ... No provision ... No provision
